🐶 DOGE – Created as a joke in 2013, but now a major player

🚀 TRUMP – President Donald Trump's official meme coin

10/12
🔮 Is SHIB a Dogecoin killer?
Some say yes, but SHIB’s strength lies in its ecosystem. Unlike DOGE, SHIB has:
✅ A DeFi exchange (ShibaSwap)
✅ A Layer-2 blockchain (Shibarium)
✅ A DAO governance model

4/12
💡 How does Shiba Inu work?
Unlike Dogecoin, SHIB is an ERC-20 token built on Ethereum, meaning:
✅ Works with DeFi apps
✅ Compatible with Ethereum wallets
✅ Easy trading on DEXs like Uniswap
